facts.fact: 屋内夜谈：从「If my Marked comes, it will depend on what you choose」到他的 love 宣言——「love was always there. Before I even met you」（不通！）——他承认自己也有多重血赋（视为最羞耻的秘密）：为她保留选择权（选人不选印）
facts.anchor: But love…love was always there. Before I even met you.

facts.fact: 反转揭幕：「我此生都在海上寻找你」——他当着她的面挽起袖子：左眼虹膜一半沉入海洋蓝、手臂自肘部长出与她完全相同的双线印记（拇指两侧同样分叉）——Draven 就是她的 Marked Match（Identical）
facts.anchor: Lavina Theron, I have sailed the seas searching for you for my entire life.

facts.fact: 她的爆裂：隐瞒=「你在拆解我」——这些天她以为自己在背叛 Marked（其实是他本人）；他跪地求答「I wanted you to have choice. I wanted you to choose a man, not a mark」——她怒斥「How merciful of you to arrange my future」
facts.anchor: You were breaking me! I felt like I was betraying him—you.

facts.fact: 旧案重启：Alden 早就知情并助攻；Lucan 也早知道——他在 Eirene 寝殿撞见的是 Draven 与 seek er Bernard（ch03 入侵者真相）——「You are the reason for the heightened security?」——Draven：「I'd be able to get in even now」
facts.anchor: You were the one who came into my sister’s chambers?

facts.fact: 她的回答：不验印、不掩饰伤——「反正我也会选你，Draven Artrayu」——他的紧张全松；但她退后一步：「It's too much. I can't…」
facts.anchor: “I would have chosen you anyway, Draven Artrayu.”

facts.fact: 怒火转向 Lucan：他早看见 Draven 的印记却知情不报（她曾把「找不到 Marked」的痛全部说给他听）——「我要把他活活烧了」；她冒雨夺门而出——「Leave me be!」——从「她找了一生的人」身边逃走
